story-context.principle: All form data (including schema definitions) must be managed from the database. Story 5.3 builds on Story 5.2 ref.FormDefaultsSchemaVersion.

in-scope.item: Backend Pydantic schema models real DefinitionJSON structure (theme, globalStyles, logic, canvasSettings, pages, desktopPages/tabletPages/mobilePages)
Validate top-level keys and key invariants (unique component IDs, logic rule integrity)
Reject or handle unknown keys explicitly (no silent ignore)
Schema versioning: track schemaVersion; document compatibility/migration strategy; integrate with ref.FormDefaultsSchemaVersion
Populate ref.FormDefaultsSchemaVersion.SchemaDocument with DefinitionJSON JSON Schema; backend validation reads from DB
GET /api/form-schema/{version}: returns schema definition from SchemaDocument; Form Builder can fetch at init
Compatibility tests: builder output (or fixtures) passes backend validation; regression protection

done-criteria.dc: Backend schema validates full DefinitionJSON structure (theme, globalStyles, canvasSettings, logic, pages with background, device-specific page arrays)
Schema versioning documented; schemaVersion validated; compatibility/migration strategy exists; schema stored in ref.FormDefaultsSchemaVersion.SchemaDocument
Compatibility tests prove builder output passes validation; regression protection
Key invariants enforced: unique component IDs, logic sourceComponentId ≠ targetComponentId
GET /api/form-schema/{version} returns DefinitionJSON JSON Schema from DB; all schema data managed from database
UAT guide executed and marked PASSED

builder-output-structure.key: 30+ fields: typography, colors, spacing, borders, layout, defaultGridLayout, defaultGridLayoutsByComponent
rules: [{ id, enabled, name?, when, then }]
builder-output-structure.form-page: id, title, components, background? (type: color|image, value?, assetRef?, placement?)
builder-output-structure.form-component: id, type, props, position?, styleOverrides?, children?, gridLayout?

story-5.2-integration.columns: SchemaVersion (INT), SchemaName, Description, SchemaDocument (NVARCHAR MAX), IsActive
story-5.2-integration.usage: Story 5.2 created this for DefaultsJSON; Story 5.3 extends: populate SchemaDocument with DefinitionJSON JSON Schema; use for validation + GET /api/form-schema/{version}
story-5.2-integration.migration: May need SchemaVersionString (e.g. "1.0") to match DefinitionJSON.schemaVersion; or document 1 → "1.0" mapping at API boundary

current-backend-gap.has: theme (minimal FormTheme), pages, logic, formId, schemaVersion
current-backend-gap.missing: globalStyles, canvasSettings, background on FormPage, desktopPages/tabletPages/mobilePages, full component structure (position, styleOverrides, gridLayout), defaultGridLayoutsByComponent
current-backend-gap.note: ComponentProps has extra="allow"; FormDefinition does not validate unknown top-level keys

task-decomposition.directive: Ralf-SM creates the full task breakdown from this story and context. Do not feel constrained by any pre-existing TASK-PLAN or task specs.
task-decomposition.constraint: Schema expansion should precede compatibility tests; tests validate the expanded schema.
Backend schema aligns to frontend builder.types.ts; do not change frontend. Use Pydantic models with extra="forbid" or explicit handling for unknown keys.

constraints.constraint: Story branch: story/epic5-5.3-schema-validation-alignment; never work on master
Task branches: task/5.3/Txx-<slug>; PR into story branch
Human runs migrations; agent never runs Alembic directly (per .cursorrules)
Backend schema must accept valid builder output without modification; builder remains source of truth for structure
All schema data managed from database; ref.FormDefaultsSchemaVersion.SchemaDocument is source of truth; no hardcoded schema in code paths that can read from DB
